name: A Hopeful Love
source:
Underneath the afternoon sun, Sarah unwinds and relaxes after school on a peaceful stroll through the park. Upon seeing her crush, she contemplates whether to face her fears or walk away. In this visual novel, this story shows how a small act of compassion and courage can go a long way in making a difference in someone's life.
